# Code map: packages/story-block

Generated by `npm run codemap` from each file's job sentence (docs/codemap/jobs-story-block.json, the package's docs/dev/codemap.md, or the file's opening comment) and the source. Do not edit by hand. The maps carry no line counts (the 450-line limit is enforced by the size check).

## Feature entry points

| Feature | Start reading at | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| Extension entry | `index.js` | What SillyTavern loads: wires the v2 runtime, packs and diagnostics. |
| Runtime start-up | `src/v2/runtime.js` | Builds the host, registers modules and hooks chat events. |
| Prompt building | `src/v2/prompt.js` | Assembles the static text and tail Story Block adds to each reply's prompt. |
| Reply capture | `src/v2/capture.js` | Reads state changes out of a finished reply. |
| Saving and persistence | `src/v2/persist.js` | Stores story state in the chat and its files. |
| Replay and rewind | `src/v2/replay.js` | Rebuilds state from the chat after a swipe, edit or delete. |
| Commands | `src/v2/commands.js` | The command registry every screen and module changes state through. |
| Module registry | `src/v2/registry.js` | registerModule: how modules add parts, screens, widgets and queries. |
| Public API | `src/v2/public-api.js` | The frozen read-only StoryBlock.api other extensions use. |
| Packs | `src/v2/packs/index.js` | Loads story packs and their events, items and rules. |
| Pack events | `src/v2/events/condition.js` | Parses and safely evaluates pack-event conditions. |
| Lean RPG (rolls, fights, gear) | `src/v2/lean-rpg/index.js` | The optional RPG module: checks, the fight board, gear and levels. |
| Fight board | `src/v2/lean-rpg/board/commit.js` | Commits staged board choices as the reply's one guarded RPG resolution. |
| Layouts and screens | `src/v2/layout/index.js` | Screen layout definitions, validation and rendering. |
| Data modules and block editor | `src/v2/data-modules/block-builder.js` | Builds and edits data-module definitions in the in-chat editor. |
| Model calls | `src/v2/model-call.js` | Helper model calls and their connection profile. |

## One job per file: backlog

Files with more than 4 exports (legacy; pure re-export facades are exempt; split when moving out of `packages/`).

- `src/v2/domains/scene/constants-parts/you.js`: 5 exports
- `testkit/fake-st.js`: 9 exports
